I’ll check both providers’ streaming conversions, fix the tool-call indices, and run the focused tests. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill.
Gemini hardcodes every tool-call index to zero, and LiteLLM replaces the upstream index with the call’s position in each chunk. I’ve updated both paths and am adding regression tests for calls across chunks, interleaved arguments, and missing indices.
All 126 tests in the two provider files passed, but pytest then hit a sandbox permission error in the repository’s process-inspection summary hook. I’ve also added an assertion that interleaved argument fragments assemble separately, and I’m rerunning those focused cases with the summary hook disabled.
Implemented the streaming index fixes:

- Gemini assigns consecutive tool-call indices across chunks, resetting for each request.
- LiteLLM preserves supplied indices, falling back to chunk position only when the index is missing or `None`.

Added regression coverage for parallel calls, interleaved arguments, and fallback behavior. All 126 provider tests passed before a sandbox error in pytest’s summary hook; the five focused regression cases reran successfully with that hook disabled.

The two out-of-scope issues remain unchanged.
